stories.title: Ukraine hit by deadly Russian strikes after Trump diesel deal
stories.summary: Russian strikes killed civilians in Ukraine the day after President Trump announced a deal to buy Russian diesel, which Kyiv warned could help bankroll Russias war. Zelenskyy said fuel-sale proceeds would intensify the conflict as European leaders reiterated support for Ukraine.

stories.title: Hurricane Isaias downgraded to post-tropical cyclone, 800,000+ without power
stories.summary: Isaias, the first hurricane of the 2026 Atlantic season, made landfall near Destin, Florida as a Category 2 storm and weakened to post-tropical as it moved inland. More than 800,000 customers lost power in Florida and Alabama amid heavy rain and flooding across the Southeast.

stories.title: Russian strikes kill at least 15 in Ukraine after Trump gets diesel deal
stories.summary: At least 15 people were killed in Russian strikes on Ukraine that Kyiv cast as retaliation for Trumps announcement that the US would buy Russian diesel. Ukrainian officials warn the deal will help fund Moscows war effort.

stories.title: A year after the Gaza ceasefire, photos show most promises unfulfilled
stories.summary: On the anniversary of the October 2025 Gaza ceasefire, photos show the deals long-term promises largely unmet, with reconstruction stalled and conditions for civilians still dire. The US-brokered hopes for a lasting peace remain unrealized.

stories.title: YouTuber says police visited after he built a Flock-style camera to track cops
stories.summary: A YouTuber who built his own license-plate-reading camera like Flock Safety said police paid him a visit over the project. The story highlights tensions around surveillance cameras and their use on law enforcement.

stories.title: The AI control gap: who gets to say an AI system is safe?
stories.summary: SiliconANGLEs Breaking Analysis argues there is a widening gap between what AI can do and the evidence supporting trusting it, centering on alignment. The open question is who decides when the evidence is sufficient to call a model safe to deploy.

stories.title: AI is getting really good at messing with cybercriminals
stories.summary: Anti-cybercrime programs are increasingly using AI to scam the scammers, tricking criminals into talking to lifelike bots they believe are real victims. It reflects a new AI-powered front in the fight against online fraud.

stories.title: Browns elevate DTs Sam Kamara and Chris Williams from the practice squad
stories.summary: Cleveland elevated defensive tackles Sam Kamara and Chris Williams from the practice squad ahead of Sundays game at the Jets. Adding depth at defensive tackle matters with DT Mason Graham ruled out.

stories.title: How the Browns will disrupt Jets QB Geno Smith: burning questions
stories.summary: Clevelands staff broke down keys to Sundays matchup with the Jets, including pressuring Geno Smith and stopping New Yorks run game with Breece Hall ruled out. The 3-1 Browns are seeking their first 4-1 start since 2020.

stories.title: Two biggest issues for Ohio State after five games: run explosiveness, pass rush
stories.summary: An analysis of all five Ohio State games finds the run game lacks 20-yard plays and the pass rush is producing under two sacks a game. Both loom as problems entering a closing stretch against Indiana, USC and Oregon.

stories.title: Ohio State should get a little weird against Maryland before a tough stretch
stories.summary: Before next weeks game at Indiana, LGHL argues Ohio State is a big enough favorite over Maryland to rest banged-up starters and give younger players more reps. The 4-1 Buckeyes host Maryland for Homecoming on Saturday.

stories.title: Verstappen takes Singapore GP pole ahead of Leclerc and Hamilton
stories.summary: Max Verstappen secured his first Singapore Grand Prix pole with a 1:31.373 lap, edging Ferraris Charles Leclerc by 0.054s, with Lewis Hamilton third. It capped a day that began with Verstappen winning the rain-hit Sprint.

stories.title: Hamilton delighted with mega start that earned P2 in Singapore Sprint
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton climbed from P6 to a podium finish in a wet Singapore Sprint, overtaking both McLarens and his teammate on the opening lap before finishing P2 behind Verstappen. He credited a strong launch on the damp Marina Bay track.

stories.title: Verstappen wins rain-affected Singapore Sprint after Russell crashes out
stories.summary: Max Verstappen won an incident-packed Sprint at the Singapore Grand Prix after championship-leading Mercedes driver George Russell crashed out of the lead on lap one. Ferraris Hamilton and Leclerc took P2 and P3.

stories.title: Russell crashes out of Singapore Sprint lead on the opening lap
stories.summary: George Russell led the Sprint from the grid only to crash out at the final corner of the opening lap in wet conditions, triggering a safety car. It ended his bid to make it back-to-back wins.

stories.title: Hurricane Isaias remnants to bring heavy rain and gusty winds to Columbus on Sunday
stories.summary: The remnants of Hurricane Isaias are forecast to bring up to two inches of rain to Columbus and much of Ohio between Sunday evening and Monday morning. Gusty winds and heavy rain are expected as the system moves through.

stories.title: Columbus deputy chief returns to full duty after internal affairs investigation
stories.summary: Columbus Police Deputy Chief Elrico Alli returned to full duty Friday after an Internal Affairs investigation. He had been relieved of duty while the division reviewed alleged violations tied to overtime and parking tickets.

stories.title: Driver seriously injured after stopped car struck on I-270 in south Columbus
stories.summary: A driver suffered critical injuries after a tractor-trailer struck a stationary car on westbound I-270 just before 3:45 a.m. early Saturday. The Franklin County Sheriffs Office said the other driver was evaluated at the scene.
